# @Generated by scripts/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_trade_league_effects.py
#   Data:    data/trade_league_goods.yaml
#   Regen:   conda run --no-capture-output -n eu5 python scripts/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_trade_league_effects.py
# Do not edit directly - modify the data file and re-run the generator.

tv_trade_league_create_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_founder
	if = {
		limit = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_league_member }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
			}
		}
		create_international_organization = {
			type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
			add_country_to_international_organization = prev
			set_leader_country = prev
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_update_monopolies_effect = {
	# horses
	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_total value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_total add = "total_effective_goods_production_buildings(goods:horses)" }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_horses value = local_var:tv_trade_global_total }
	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_horses value = local_var:tv_trade_global_total }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_market_present_in_country = {
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = traded_in_market:horses }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_horses value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_horses value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_horses > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses value = var:tv_trade_io_horses }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses divide = var:tv_trade_global_horses }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses >= 0.5 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_horses value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_horses add = 0.1 }
		}
	}

			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = traded_in_market:saffron }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_saffron value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_saffron value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_saffron value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_saffron > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_saffron value = var:tv_trade_io_saffron }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_saffron divide = var:tv_trade_global_saffron }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_saffron >= 0.5 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_saffron value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_saffron add = 0.1 }
		}
	}

			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = traded_in_market:fine_cloth }
		}
	}

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_fine_cloth value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fine_cloth value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_fine_cloth > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fine_cloth value = var:tv_trade_io_fine_cloth }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_fine_cloth divide = var:tv_trade_global_fine_cloth }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_fine_cloth >= 0.5 }

	set_global_variable = { name = tv_trade_global_wheat value = local_var:tv_trade_global_total }

	set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total value = 0 }
	every_international_organization_member = {
		every_market_present_in_country = {
			change_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_total add = traded_in_market:wheat }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_io_wheat value = local_var:tv_trade_io_total }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_wheat value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wheat value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_global_wheat > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wheat value = var:tv_trade_io_wheat }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wheat divide = var:tv_trade_global_wheat }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_wheat >= 0.5 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_wheat value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_level_wheat add = 0.1 }
		}
	}
